entries.question: Can ChatGPT connect to Workday and other enterprise systems?
alternates: Do you integrate with our HRIS?
entries.answer: Yes. Custom GPT Actions connect ChatGPT to systems such as Workday, Salesforce (with Gong), GitHub, Google Calendar, Canvas and SharePoint. For Workday, Custom Actions support HR processes, task automation and personalized employee support; the OpenAI Cookbook has reference implementations.
entries.quote: ChatGPT’s Custom Actions with Workday allow organizations to use AI to improve HR processes, automate tasks, and offer personalized employee support.
